portable_artifact_limits: Embedded command output is exact text decoded with replacement for any invalid byte; command SHA-256 values bind the original raw byte streams.
NPU raw snapshots are bound by digest and empty-process parsing; they are not duplicated ten times per order in this portable artifact.
This artifact records one true-negative case and cannot establish full H2 precision/recall.

causal_chain: KNorm replaces selected existing scheduler req_to_blocks positions with the null block and returns the old physical blocks to the free queue, including immediate reuse for uncached blocks.
Host CachedRequestData communicates only new_block_ids; for non-resumed requests its protocol specifies append semantics.
Host GPUModelRunner extends retained block IDs and appends the same IDs to the device-facing persistent block table; it has no indexed replacement field for KNorm scheduler mutations.

After an evicted physical block ID is reused, the worker may retain that ID at the old logical position while also appending it for a new allocation. Launching the active pair would therefore risk scheduler/worker/device KV-address disagreement.
